options.content: Did the new run regress? · Every delta below is the new run measured against the reference run. Green = no regression; red = needs attention.

REFERENCE RUN · BEFORE
The comparison point. All changes below are measured from this run.
$baseline_ref
ROS $baseline_distro · commit $baseline_commit · run $baseline_run

NEW RUN · AFTER
The result being evaluated. Red signals mean this run became worse.
$candidate_ref
ROS $candidate_distro · commit $candidate_commit · run $candidate_run
